Hikaru Genji - Roller Panic.name: Hikaru Genji: Roller Panic
Hikaru Genji - Roller Panic.summary: J-pop boy band Hikaru Genji always perform on roller skates, but on the day of their performance at Tokyo Dome (in all but name), the band's roller skates have all been stolen. In this Japanese-style adventure game, you play as a fan of Hikaru Genji who volunteered to help them find the skate thieves and retrieve the band's skates.
